title: cloud: state the persisted visualize_data result shape after cloud#3292 (chart descriptor key, row cap), so ui can redraw charts after a reload
body:
Source: split by the ui seat (`domain:ui#4`) from #25908, at the maintainer's rule 「cloud 相关的任务,转 cloud 车道处理」 (2026-10-27T14:08Z). The ui card thread stopped before editing (report 6442837522) because the cloud side could not be read: `objectstack-ai/cloud` is not reachable from the ui lane, and npm `@objectstack/service-ai` latest is 10.3.0, which predates objectstack-ai/cloud#3292.

## What the cloud lane answers

On `objectstack-ai/cloud` at or after #3292, read the `visualize_data` tool's result as it is **persisted** with the conversation (the shape a reload hydrates, not only the streamed one), and state on this card:

1. the key path that holds the full chart descriptor in the persisted result;
2. whether the persisted rows are capped (the ui thread was told 20), and where the cap is set;
3. the cloud `file:line` for each, and the `@objectstack/service-ai` version that ships it (or "unreleased").

Done when: a comment on this card answers 1 to 3 with cloud `file:line` citations. That comment unblocks #25908.

## Why ui needs it

#25908: an assistant answer's chart disappears after a reload. The ui read points are already measured, and nothing is written until the shape is known:

- hydration: app-shell `src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx:206` (second caller console `SharedRecordPage.tsx:181`);
- cache: app-shell `src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts:441`;
- plugin-chatbot `useObjectChat.ts:743` → `mapMessages.ts` `extractCharts:1440`.

Reading an assumed key was ruled out. Declaring the shape in `packages/spec` would owe a contract review the ui lane does not take, so it is not done from ui.

No ui code is part of this card.
